in_sanskrit.name: धया
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who gives, the giver, the donor, the benefactor

in_marathi.name: Dhaya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhaya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhaya is a Sanskrit name meaning 'gift' or 'grace'. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of the goddess Dhaya Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity. She is often depicted as holding a lotus flower and showering her blessings on her devotees.
